title: /render-from-format
summary: Slash command that compiles a format IR plus new content into a short_video_spec render plan, renders it with new or licensed assets and runs QA.
description: Render a new video from a lifted format IR and new content. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe and Python modules; writes evidence, answers, IR and reports under the chosen output directory
